response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced engineer with genuine geospatial platform experience (GISCollective, Green Map) and low-latency systems work in DLang, but falls short on the core requirements: modern C++ experience is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments a decade ago, there is no Rust, and no experience building navigation/routing systems or map-data pipelines at production scale. Recent work has centered on TypeScript/Node full-stack and product engineering, making this a stretch fit for a C++-centric routing tiling role, though the systems and GIS foundation makes a borderline case worth a light-touch screen.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial experience via founding and building the GISCollective open-source GIS platform
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (millions of HTTP req/sec) using async I/O, caching, and fibers in DLang
Broad full-stack adaptability and demonstrated willingness to learn new technologies across many domains
concerns: No modern C++ or Rust experience; last C/C++ work was a short role in 2014–2015
No routing, navigation guidance, or map-tiling pipeline experience
Recent career trajectory is TypeScript/Node product engineering, far from systems-level data pipeline work
